name: what WILL.remain();
source:
Rayan is a former soldier from Vivara who migrates to Tekrena, a highly developed country where humans and androids coexist.

He tries to start a new life, and meets Roméo, a doctor, and Diane, an android, who become his new friends.

However, the past soon catches up with him when he meets William, an android who looks exactly like his fallen comrade, Liam, who died in the war. 

[From [url=https://cleanne.itch.io/what-willremain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Rayan是一名来自Vivara的前士兵，他移居到Tekrena，这是一个人类和机器人共存的高度发达的国家。

他试图开始新的生活，并遇到了医生罗密欧和机器人黛安，他们成为了他的新朋友。

然而，当他遇到威廉时，过去很快就追上了他，威廉是一个长得酷似他在战争中阵亡的战友利亚姆的机器人。

[来自[url=https://cleanne.itch.io/what-willremain]itch.io[/url]]
